marta: Quick sync — I'm finishing the release notes for 2.15.0 (runtime perf + routing-fallback polish). Need docs/ops/legal sign-off today so I can pin and schedule. Target pin: 2025-02-12 16:00 PT. Deploy window: 2025-02-13 02:00-06:00 UTC. Who can run final smoke and cover APAC?
ryan: I'll run the smoke for APAC and US (01:30-03:30 UTC). Smoke checklist: health, 4 gen prompts (short/long/edge), 2 embeddings, KV warmup, routing-fallback to regional variant. Will post logs here. Revert tag: `revert/2.15.0`.
priya: Comms plan: autopost to `internal-announce` when canary reaches 30%. Ill prepare localized one-liners for APAC/EU and include ops runbook bullets + ping list.
jen: Docs note: include "version pin (artifact SHA)" language and a curl example showing the `truncate` param. Also add a short rollback criteria section (e.g., rollback if client error rate >1.6% sustained 7m OR p95 token latency +170ms for 10m).
deploy-bot: INFO: Canary plan stored: 4% -> 30% -> 70% -> 100% with 10m ramps. Auto-rollback if canary error delta >1.25% OR p95 latency delta >160ms vs baseline. Preview: `/deploy start v2.15.0 --canary=4,30,70 --ramp=10m --annotations="comms:autopost,ops-runbook:attached"`
marta: Added rollback criteria, revert tag, and Dedicated FAQ blurb to the draft. Draft link: https://docs.internal/releases/2.15.0-draft 94 please comment inline. Ill pin at 2025-02-12 16:00 PT if no objections.
ryan: 44d Ill post smoke logs here during the window and call revert if routing fallback in APAC fails.
priya: 44d prepping announce copy. Will attach ops runbook and who to ping.
jen: 44d docs sign-off (small wording tweak pushed).
marta: Pinning at 2025-02-12 16:00 PT unless an objection. Ill set deploybot annotations so internal announce autoposts at 30%. Thanks all.
